tool_args.rationale: The 10 paid observations vary u_now and s_grad and support a smooth, nonlinear bridge-response fit; they do not identify horizon-dependent transfer dynamics. Fit coefficients numerically from the training data and use fresh confirmation to test whether this compact response law meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the resulting rows establish a pronounced s_grad dependence.
Already acquired, and all observed horizons remain 0.6, so additional same-horizon rows are less informative than fitting the measured response.
The paid rows do not vary H, x_now, u_past, or mem_conv; those dynamics cannot be identified from this design.
It is not relevant to identifying the measured smooth response and is explicitly a nuisance probe.
